pre_boundary_region.rule: Every statement between the signature and `try {` must initialise from a module constant, a literal, or a lambda body that does not execute yet. pre_boundary_region.why: ROUND-9 BLOCKER 2: an exit above the boundary carries no run record, so it pins no producer. interior_collapse.statement: For a driver call edge wrapped by perform(K), a fault raised in the callee’s transitive interior emits OF(K) — UNLESS a local catch in that interior converts the fault into a degraded RETURN VALUE first. That is not a silent loss: for every driver-reachable PO method below, the degraded value is either consumed by a driver-side check that fails typed, or the absorption is deliberate and individually justified.
interior_collapse.round_9_correction: The round-8 artifact stated the collapse unconditionally. That was FALSE and the reviewer was right. The absorbing set turns out to be small and enumerable rather than pervasive; `lessonEnded`, one of the two examples cited, in fact reaches a producer on every driver edge — recorded here for precision, not as a defence of the original claim.

routed_layer.authored: 2026-08-16, rebuilt after gate-B round 5 (injectable boundary: runGatedLote)
routed_layer.derivation: TypeScript AST over runGatedLote’s body (module_sites) and the gated test body (spec_residual_sites), contract kinds: ThrowStatements (argument constructors absorbed); catch branch; finally/cleanup (none present — classifier active); returns recorded for closure (success path vs failure-path early return by region); awaited chains are exits only WITHOUT a local handler — a handler must be a FUNCTION LITERAL (arrow or function expression) in a .catch or a two-armed .then rejection slot — argless .catch(), .then(ok, undefined) and identifier-valued slots do NOT handle; awaited parenthesized/ternary shapes unwrap and classify each branch; remaining calls/constructors are potential throws. The witness re-derives both tables each run, both directions. EXIT ROWS carry per-site producers by region; locally-handled awaits and success returns are recorded SEPARATELY under non_exit_closure (they are not contract exit kinds), so the sites tables are exactly the contract exit universe.

region_owners.module try: spec-catch equivalent: runGatedLote’s own catch — seal (when armed and not yet frozen), guarded bail dump with failureText, unconditional identical rethrow
region_owners.module catch: guarded-cleanup: every cleanup await individually guarded; even dump-argument evaluation (poison.fired) is guarded; the original error always rethrows
region_owners.spec body: test-red: pre-arming guards (nothing armed) or post-boundary verdict assertions (journal frozen and evidence dumped inside runGatedLote before return)

fail_totality: armShadowCapture arms the detachable recorder LAST; the two Playwright-irreversible installs (binding, init script) precede it and are inert without it — binding stamps into a core nothing reads, the init script optional-chains the binding (fault-injection witnesses: init-script fault and attach fault both reject with zero listeners installed).

The spec catch is fail-total: finish faults still attempt the dump, dump faults are reported via failureText without replacing the cause, and the rethrow is unconditional (AST witness: last catch statement is the rethrow; every catch-region await is guard-wrapped).
routed_layer.witness: adaptive-exit-inventory.spec.ts routed-layer describe (bidirectional set equality on both tables) + adaptive-gated-run.spec.ts (per-site activation)
routed_layer.catch_interior_allowlist: the catch-region `throw` rows are exactly {failureText, poison?.fired, console.log, console.warn, throw armError}: failureText is TOTAL (unit-witnessed over hostile values), poison?.fired reads a closure boolean, console methods are the logging sink; a new catch-interior call shows up as a set inequality and must justify itself here.
routed_layer.structure: The routed failure boundary was EXTRACTED into src/systems/torus/tasks/AdaptiveStrictGatedRun.ts (runGatedLote) so every routed exit is fault-injectable OFFLINE — the round-5 refusal of the writer position is discharged by execution, not argument. The spec is now a thin caller: one awaited runGatedLote call, the two verdict assertions, and guards.
